name: Grilled prawn skewers with couscous
steps: Toss the prawns with olive oil, paprika, cumin and salt.
Thread onto skewers and heat the grill to high.
Grill for two minutes each side until charred and pink.
Pour hot water over the couscous and let it steam for five minutes.
Fluff the couscous and serve the skewers on top.
